privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains how Go Cosmic handles personal data on this website and when you contact the studio by email.
privacy.legalNoticePrefix: For publisher and hosting details, see the

sections.title: Data controller
body: The data controller is Go Cosmic, represented by Matthieu Compérat. The studio can be contacted at support@gocosmic.dev for privacy requests.

sections.title: Data collected
body: The website has no account area, checkout, CAPTCHA, or advertising pixel. Two forms are handled server-side. The free mockup page collects your email address, the colour direction you pick, the address of your current website if you provide one, your message, and the language of the page. If you arrive from the pricing simulator, the request also includes the choices you made there — project type, site type, number of pages, selected options, update frequency and the resulting estimated monthly price — so the studio can answer with the full context. The contact form collects the name, email address and message you enter, plus the optional subject, phone number and company. In both cases the fields are forwarded to the studio mailbox by email and nothing is stored in a database. Messages sent through the mailto links are handled by your email client and the recipient mailbox instead.

Your IP address is processed transiently by the hosting provider's firewall, which limits both forms — the contact form and the free mockup form — to three submissions every ten minutes, alongside a hidden anti-spam field in each. Technical data may be processed by the hosting provider for security and delivery logs. Vercel Analytics is loaded only after consent to measure page views.

Two items are stored in your browser. The pricing simulation is kept only so it can follow you from the simulator to the free mockup form: it is sent to us only if you submit that form, is erased once the request is sent, and disappears when you close the tab. The dates of your recent contact form submissions are used to limit how often the form can be sent from the same browser and stay there until you clear your browser data; they are never sent to us.

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases
body: Email messages are processed to answer requests, prepare quotes, provide support, and keep evidence of exchanges. This processing is based on legitimate interest and, where applicable, pre-contractual steps requested by you. Free mockup requests are processed to prepare and send you the mockup you asked for, and to reply to you.

Messages sent through the contact form are processed for the same purposes. Limiting submissions per IP address and filtering automated submissions rely on the legitimate interest in protecting the service from abuse.

Audience measurement is used to understand aggregate traffic and improve the website. Go Cosmic loads Vercel Analytics only after your consent. Security logs are processed for legitimate interest in protecting the service.

sections.title: Recipients and processors
body: Data may be accessed by Go Cosmic, the email service provider, Resend (which delivers the free mockup and contact form emails), the hosting provider, and Vercel for hosting and analytics. LinkedIn is an external website and may process data under its own policy after you click an outbound link.

sections.title: Retention periods
body: Email exchanges are kept only for the time needed to handle the request and follow-up, then archived or deleted according to legal, accounting, or dispute limitation needs. Audience consent is stored in your browser until you clear local storage or change browsers. Hosting logs are retained according to the provider configuration.
Contact form submissions are not kept in a database: they are delivered as an email, and the resulting exchange follows the retention described above.

sections.title: International transfers
body: Some processors, including Vercel and email providers, may involve processing outside the European Economic Area.
Vercel frames these transfers using Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission. For questions about the applicable safeguards, contact support@gocosmic.dev.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, and portability when applicable by writing to support@gocosmic.dev. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL: https://www.cnil.fr/.

sections.title: Cookies and audience measurement
body: No advertising cookies are intentionally loaded by Go Cosmic. Vercel Analytics is treated as a non-essential audience measurement tool on this site and is loaded only after your consent.
You can modify or withdraw your consent at any time using the preference management button displayed at the bottom of every page.
